best_idea: A client-only death or impact effect can settle on a fixed step with a per-prop still-moving test and emit one done signal that nothing in the engine waits on.
decision_why: Take the shape (fixed-step integrate, edge bounce with restore and one-axis flip, settle test, one done signal) for dropped armour and weapons on the Pit sand after a server-verified kill; change to 3D, a fixed step and a hard cap, because the donor is frame-rate dependent and 2D. Gives a death a physical beat without touching kills, loot or XP.
acceptance: A player sees the dropped shield tumble, bounce and stop on the sand within a fixed time at 60 Hz and 120 Hz alike; a server test asserts the kill and loot ledger entry exist before the client starts the scatter, and no code path waits on the settle signal.
